description: RAS2FIM is NOAA Office of Water Prediction's Python workflow for generating flood-inundation raster libraries from one-dimensional HEC-RAS models. It aligns hydraulic reaches with National Water Model streams and derives depth maps and reach-averaged rating curves for multiple discharges. Inputs are georeferenced HEC-RAS models, terrain, hydrofabric and model-catalogue metadata; outputs are inundation grids and curves that can be paired with forecast flows. Coverage follows the available United States hydraulic models. Source is free under Apache-2.0. A limitation is that the documented workflow requires Windows and HEC-RAS 6.3, while the supplied ESIP example-data collection requires separately issued credentials. Code availability does not establish unrestricted access to that collection. RAS2FIM can support infrastructure flood-exposure simulations and complements HEC-RAS (model-hec-ras). The README also distinguishes this hydraulic workflow from HAND-based mapping. No sample data, hydraulic models, credentials or installer were obtained.
